message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: In May 2014, Li (already convicted) had vehicle damaged, conspired with defendant Huang to stage a traffic accident to claim insurance money. On June 1, 2014 night, Huang, together with others, drove Li's car (a Geely Emgrand) on a road, intentionally crashed into a tree causing accident. Huang lacked a driver's license; they had Li2 (already convicted) pose as driver, claiming accident caused by Li2. Insurance company paid 24,800 yuan to Li. After, Huang and Li2 returned the cash to insurance. On Oct 27, Huang turned himself in (self-surrender). Evidence includes many documents.

So the crime is insurance fraud (insurance scam). The label list includes "保险诈骗". That matches.

Any other charges? Possibly "危险驾驶" because they intentionally caused crash, but they were not driving under influence, but they intentionally caused accident. The charge "危险驾驶" is used for dangerous driving (e.g., drunk driving). Here they intentionally caused crash, maybe "破坏交通工具"? Not exactly. The main is insurance fraud. Also "妨害公务"? No. "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章"? No. "非法持有、私藏枪支"? No. So just "保险诈骗".

Check list: "保险诈骗" is present. So answer: [罪名]保险诈骗<eoa>
